settings.title: Auto-align kit in the box
settings.text: The frame lines it up for you. Straight and bubble free on the first try.

settings.title: Case friendly
settings.text: Edges stop just short of the curve, so it works with almost every case.

settings.title: 30-day returns
settings.text: Not happy with it? Send it back within 30 days.

settings.title: Privacy redefined
settings.text: Micro-louver glass lets light through straight ahead and blocks it from the side. Face it and it is clear. Anyone beside you sees a black screen.

settings.title: Tough 9H glass
settings.text: Tempered glass takes the scratches, drops and keys in your pocket, so your real screen does not have to.

settings.title: Fits your exact model
settings.text: Cut for your iPhone, with cutouts for the speaker and camera. Works with Face ID and most cases.

settings.title: Thin and smooth
settings.text: Ultra-thin with an oil-resistant coating. Touch feels the same, and fingerprints wipe right off.

settings.title: Clean the screen
settings.text: Use the wet wipe, then the dry cloth. Lift any last dust with a dust sticker.

settings.title: Drop it in the frame
settings.text: Set your phone in the auto-align frame, peel the film and let the glass fall into place.

settings.title: Press and done
settings.text: Press from the center out. Full glue bonds the whole surface, so there are no bubbles or halo edges.
